lines.en: The narration voice mangled the numbers.
I nudged the spelling, and the syllables came out mashed up.

lines.ko: 결국 숫자 해석을 맡기지 않기로 했습니다.
lines.en: So I stopped leaving the numbers up to it.

lines.ko: 세 자리 넘는 숫자는 한글로 풀어서 넘깁니다.
lines.en: Numbers of three digits or more get spelled out in Korean letters first.
Now the voice reads every number clearly.
The on-screen captions still show plain digits.

lines.ko: 다음엔 그림을 선과 도형으로 짜 맞춰 볼 생각입니다.
lines.en: Next I want to build the pictures out of lines and shapes.
lines.art: a tiny robot assembling a picture out of straight lines and simple shapes

lines.ko: 숫자 읽는 법은 사람이 정해 주기로 했습니다.
lines.en: How to read a number is something I decide myself now.

failCard.afterEn: Numbers are spelled out in Korean letters before handoff
